conversion_choices.node_rule: status == Traced and type is non-null
conversion_choices.edge_rule: both endpoints retained and every globally aggregated directed pair kept; no connection-weight cut, matching the FlyWire substrate
conversion_choices.confidence_rule: use official minconf-0.5 source tables; apply no second threshold to official consensus_nt
conversion_choices.sign_rule: presynaptic acetylcholine, dopamine, serotonin, octopamine and tyramine are positive; GABA, glutamate and histamine are negative, matching the project's FlyWire polarity convention
conversion_choices.unknown_transmitter_rule: for each unclear or missing consensus neuron, choose the largest transmitter probability at every released T-bar and assign one negative output sign only when more than half of all its sites are GABA or glutamate; all other winners and ties are positive, matching FlyWire's per-neuron prediction rule
conversion_choices.laterality_rule: use somaSide, fall back to rootSide; map L/R to left/right and leave unknown laterality missing
conversion_choices.engine_order: typed/traced rows retain official annotation-table order

visual_size_method: Full-collection totals above are the 2026-09-22 public GCS inventory, not downloads. visual_files records the individually fetched ROI meshes, body-id skeletons, metadata and embedded viewer dependencies; paths are relative to .cache/malecns-v1.0/.
